#Coinbase Derivatives delays #DOGE contract launch to April 29.

Coinbase has postponed the launch of Dogecoin (DOGE) futures contracts from April 1st to April 29th after sending letters about the proposed contracts to the CFTC for self-certification.

#Dogecoin’s  candlestick shows that the bulls are trying to protect the $0.12 support.
The recovery is likely to reach the $0.18 , a significant level to watch out for. If buyers overcome this barrier, the DOGE/USDT pair could reach the top of channel. https://t.co/s3rGiLyGOd
